name: ai-usage-indicator
description: GNOME Shell extension for AI usage monitoring — daemon + extension build system

scripts.build: npm run build:daemon && npm run build:ext
scripts.install: npm run install:daemon && npm run install:ext
scripts.install:daemon: npm run build:daemon && install -Dm755 target/release/ai-usage-indicator ~/.local/bin/ai-usage-indicator && install -Dm644 ai-usage-indicator.service ~/.config/systemd/user/ai-usage-indicator.service && systemctl --user daemon-reload && systemctl --user enable --now ai-usage-indicator.service
scripts.install:ext: npm run build:ext && mkdir -p ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/gnome-ai-usage-indicator@amadeu01.github.io && cp -r ts-src/dist/* ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/gnome-ai-usage-indicator@amadeu01.github.io/ && cp ts-src/metadata.json ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/gnome-ai-usage-indicator@amadeu01.github.io/ && cp ts-src/stylesheet.css ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/gnome-ai-usage-indicator@amadeu01.github.io/ && cp -r ts-src/schemas ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/gnome-ai-usage-indicator@amadeu01.github.io/ && cp -r ts-src/icons ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/gnome-ai-usage-indicator@amadeu01.github.io/ && glib-compile-schemas ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/gnome-ai-usage-indicator@amadeu01.github.io/schemas/
scripts.debug: npm run stop; RUST_LOG=debug RUST_BACKTRACE=1 cargo run
scripts.ext:reload: npm run install:ext && if [ -n "$DISPLAY" ]; then gnome-extensions disable gnome-ai-usage-indicator@amadeu01.github.io 2>/dev/null; gnome-extensions enable gnome-ai-usage-indicator@amadeu01.github.io 2>/dev/null; echo 'Extension reloaded'; else echo 'Wayland: log out and back in to reload extension'; fi
scripts.stop: systemctl --user stop ai-usage-indicator.service 2>/dev/null; pkill -TERM -x ai-usage-indicator 2>/dev/null; echo 'Stopped ai-usage-indicator'
scripts.uninstall: npm run uninstall:daemon && npm run uninstall:ext
scripts.uninstall:daemon: npm run stop; systemctl --user disable ai-usage-indicator.service 2>/dev/null; rm -f ~/.local/bin/ai-usage-indicator; rm -f ~/.config/systemd/user/ai-usage-indicator.service; systemctl --user daemon-reload
scripts.clean: npm run clean:daemon && npm run clean:ext
